newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July motorcycle output up 1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan July motorcycle output up 1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production rose 1.6 percent in July from a year earlier to 236,989 units, the first year-on-year gain in nine months, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association said on Thursday.
Motorcycle sales rose 1.7 percent from a year earlier to 101,592 in July, the third successive month it has gained on a year-on-year basis.
The association said it expected motorcycle exports in July to have risen about six percent from a year earlier.
It will announce official export figures on Friday.
